subject: ProofPoint MAP + acceptance tests / proposed exit schedule
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Parker <ellie@proofpoint.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP + acceptance-tests (first pass)

Team — looping you both in on ProofPoint's evaluation plan. Attached is a first-pass MAP and a lightweight acceptance-test matrix I sketched during last week's call. High level asks: please review and flag any operational blockers or missing test vectors by EOD Tuesday so we can share a tidy version with ProofPoint ahead of the demo.

Key items I want explicit alignment on:
- Success criteria: 3 measurable KPIs (latency P95, false-positive rate on rerank, embed recall on N=50).
- Exit gates: smoke regression pass, 48-hour stability window at target throughput, and customer acceptance sign-off on 10 sample queries.
- Acceptance tests: short automations + manual edge-case review; see sheet for scope.

Proposed milestone dates (draft):
1) MAP finalization: 2026-08-10
2) Internal smoke + load: 2026-08-17
3) Customer proofpoint demo + acceptance window: 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-26
4) Go/no-go / contractual close: 2026-08-30

Attachments: proofpoint_map_v0.1.docx, acceptance-test-matrix.xlsx

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Parker <ellie@proofpoint.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance-tests (first pass)

Thanks Aditya — quick read-through. A few operational notes and suggested edits:

1) Load profile: the MAP references a target of 200 req/s burst; we should call out sustained 120 req/s for 60m in the acceptance test to reflect their expected traffic.
2) KV cache validation: add a KV-cache warmup step and a token-cost snapshot (we've seen cost variance pre/post-warmup).
3) Rollback criteria: include an explicit failover to the lower-capacity model variant if error-rate > 3% for 5m.

I've attached a version with inline comments (proofpoint_map_v0.1.docx). If we agree, I'll move those into the acceptance-test-matrix and add concrete runbook owners.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Parker <ellie@proofpoint.ai>, Sam Torres <s.torres@proofpoint.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance-tests (first pass)

Great start. Adding a few clarifications inline and a short customer-facing "what success looks like" paragraph we can put in the MSA appendix.

A couple of asks from my side:
- Can we scope the 10 sample queries to include at least 3 long-context (>800 tokens) prompts and 2 adversarial prompts? Those are the highest risk for ProofPoint.
- Requesting engineering owners in the matrix (I'll volunteer Evan for rollout/rollback + runbook author).
- Suggest we move the demo up one day (start 2026-08-23) to give a 48h buffer before contractual close.

Proposed revision plan: Ben to finalize operational edits by 2026-08-06 noon PT; Aditya will consolidate and send the customer-facing MAP on 2026-08-07. Once ProofPoint signs off on scope, we'll lock the acceptance-test runs and calendar.

Subject: Re: Draft MAP + acceptance-tests (first pass)

Appreciate the clear plan. A few items from our side to confirm before you finalize:

- We agree on the three KPIs but want the latency P95 measured with our production sample (we'll share the dataset subset).
- The adversarial prompts are important — we'll provide 8 seed cases and ask Redwood to add 2 more during testing.
- For the 48-hour stability window: we'd prefer that the 48 hours include at least one synthetic traffic spike to validate autoscaling/fallbacks.

We're flexible on moving the demo to Aug 23 — that works. Also, please include a one-paragraph acceptance note we can sign after we run the 10 sample queries. We prefer sign-off via DocuSign link (we'll route internally).

Looking forward to the updated doc.

Best,
Ellie Parker
Sr. Product Operations | ProofPoint AI
ellie@proofpoint.ai

- Ben: finalize operational edits and add runbook owners in acceptance-test-matrix (due 2026-08-06 12:00 PT). Attachment: acceptance-test-matrix.xlsx
- Lauren: author customer-facing "what success looks like" paragraph and Docusign-ready acceptance note (due 2026-08-07 10:00 PT).
- Aditya: consolidate into customer-facing MAP, schedule demo for 2026-08-23 09:00 PT (we'll send calendar invites once Lauren's paragraph is in).
- ProofPoint (Ellie/Sam): share the production sample subset + adversarial seeds by EOD 2026-08-07 so Ben can map to test vectors.

I'll push the consolidated MAP to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bProofPointMAP once Lauren's paragraph lands. Planning to circulate the customer-facing MAP on 2026-08-07 after we confirm owners.

If there are no major objections, we'll lock milestone dates this week and post the final MAP to HubSpot (HS-987654).
